name: Context: the learner model the tutor reads (goals, plan, mastery, weak skills, recent mistakes, misconceptions)
does: Before each reply the tutor gets a budgeted block, in priority order: the page, what is on screen, goals, ACT dates and scores, the plan and reviews due, mastery counts and weak skills, recent mistakes, frequent misconceptions, recent and upcoming lessons, interests and measured study patterns, and own-material courses (about 900 tokens, later sections cut first).

does: The interests the learner typed in onboarding or on their profile are given to the tutor so it can draw examples from them.

does: The tutor is told how the learner studies from their scorecard (measured from their own answers and sessions), described as still being learned. It is deliberately never told a 'visual/auditory/kinesthetic' learning style.
